propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 section that searches the tracker for existing duplicate reports before Phase 1, causing the debug workflow to miss 759 closed bug tickets and risk filing duplicates

The reported-against version cannot be derived from a non-existent rebar-version ticket field; it must be reconstructed from report text or the ticket's created_at timestamp (in nanoseconds) converted to unix seconds for git log queries

The Step 0 duplicate-link writeback action is not pre-approved in the approval-gate carve-out list, which currently enumerates only RCA comment, caused_by link, Step-7 siblings, not-a-bug comment, and final report

Raw nanosecond created_at values piped directly into git --before= silently return the tip instead of a historical floor; the conversion via @$(( created_at / 1000000000 )) is required and not documented
Step 0 must confirm worktree currency (HEAD == origin/main) and establish a reported-against floor sha to scope the hypothesis stage's suspect-code history search
